import sys, time, resource, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from offline_discovery.rule_remove import attach_hits, score_clusters, exact_key_count
rng=random.Random(2)
L=16
clusters=[]
for i in range(2048):
    base=1515+ (i%20)
    clusters.append({'id':i*2,'class':i%2,'members':[i*2,i*2+1],'core':[i*2,i*2+1],
                     'length':L,'range':[[base, base+3] for _ in range(L)]})
validation=[]
for r in range(8192):
    validation.append({'class': r%2, 'values':[1515 + rng.randrange(40) for _ in range(128)]})
start=time.time()
attach_hits(clusters, validation, 2)
print('attach_hits %.2fs rss=%dMB' % (time.time()-start, resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss//1024))
start=time.time()
kept=score_clusters(clusters, validation, 2, (1,10))
print('score %.2fs kept=%d' % (time.time()-start, len(kept)))
start=time.time()
n=exact_key_count(kept, 8192)
print('exact_key_count %.2fs entries=%d' % (time.time()-start, n))
# heavy overlap exact count: many boxes sharing one coordinate
clusters2=[]
for i in range(2048):
    clusters2.append({'length':2,'range':[[0,0],[i, i+5]]})
start=time.time()
print('overlap boxes', exact_key_count(clusters2, 8192), '%.2fs' % (time.time()-start))
clusters3=[]
for i in range(2048):
    clusters3.append({'length':3,'range':[[0,1],[i%4, i%4+1],[0,2]]})
start=time.time()
print('nested boxes', exact_key_count(clusters3, 8192), '%.2fs' % (time.time()-start))
PYEOF
